    Spatial AI for Real-World Intelligence

    Deeyook turns ubiquitous wireless signals into real-time spatial understanding — indoors and outdoors, at scale, without new infrastructure.

    From location to context, from signals to intelligence.

    Anchor 1

    Deeyook offers a fundamentally different approach to asset tracking, leveraging existing Wi-Fi networks with our patented interferometry technology. This breakthrough enables precise, sub-meter location accuracy, indoors and outdoors, without the cost and complexity of proprietary infrastructure.
